arxiv-1907-02682.title: Extension property of continuous functions in a Riemannain manifold with a pole
arxiv-1907-02682.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh 1 ∗ and Chandan Kumar Mondal 2
arxiv-1907-02682.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Absos Ali Shaikh 1 ∗ and Chandan Kumar Mondal 2. The Brouwer fixed point theorem says that any continuous function from disc to itself has a fixed point. By using simple geometrical technique we have generalized the result in manifold and proved that any continuous function on the boundary of a bounded convex domain of a 2 2 -dimensional Riemannian manifold with a pole having at least one fixed point can be extended to the convex domain without any interior fixed point.

arxiv-2203-05072.description: Abstract . Shuffle is one of the most expensive communication primitives in distributed data processing and is difficult to scale. Prior work addresses the scalability challenges of shuffle by building monolithic shuffle systems. These systems are costly to develop, and they are tightly integrated with batch processing frameworks that offer only high-level APIs such as SQL.

arxiv-2504-00307.title: Diffusion models for probabilistic precipitation generation from atmospheric variables Thanks: Contact: Michael Aich, michael.aich@tum.de
arxiv-2504-00307.creator: Michael Aich, Sebastian Bathiany, Philipp Hess, Yu Huang, Niklas Boers
arxiv-2504-00307.description: Abstract Improving the representation of precipitation in Earth system models (ESMs) is critical for assessing the impacts of climate change and especially of extreme events like floods and droughts. In existing ESMs, precipitation is not resolved explicitly, but represented by parameterizations. These typically rely on resolving approximated but computationally expensive column-based physics, not accounting for interactions between locations.

arxiv-2505-05824.description: Abstract Ferrimagnetism typically emerges from chemically distinct magnetic ions or mixed-valence states. pmc-13292223.title: Nearest-Neighbor Effects in Short Unfolded Peptides: An Assessment of Molecular Dynamics Force Fields
pmc-13292223.creator: Athul Suresh, Reinhard Schweitzer-Stenner, Brigita Urbanc
pmc-13292223.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Molecular dynamics (MD) is a unique tool for the investigation of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs); however, the reliability of MD predictions depends on the accuracy of the underlying force field. Here, we evaluate CHARMM36m, Amber ff14SB, and Amber ff24EXP-GA with respect to their capacity to capture experimentally observed nearest-neighbor (NN) effects on the conformational dynamics of amino acid residues in short unfolded peptides in water.

pmc-13482596.title: Mechanisms of gut microbiota metabolite-mediated gut-heart Axis in heart failure: An integrative study based on network pharmacology☆
pmc-13482596.creator: Feng Tan, Yuan Cheng, Jianwei Yan, Zeqi Zheng
pmc-13482596.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHeart failure (HF) is a prevalent terminal-stage cardiovascular disease worldwide. Recent years have seen growing research on the gut-heart axis, yet the role of gut microbiota-derived metabolites in HF pathogenesis remains insufficiently explored.MethodsThis network pharmacology study screened overlapping targets of heart failure and gut metabolites via gutMGene, GeneCards and OMIM databases, then carried out PPI, enrichment, M-S-M-T network construction, as well as drug-likeness and toxicity prediction of metabolites.ResultsWe identified 47 candidate targets at the intersection of HF-related genes and gut metabolite-associated targets.

pmc-13531889.title: Exploring value-creating contexts in the capacity building of nursing managers: a reflective thematic analysis
pmc-13531889.creator: Mohammad Azim Mahmodi, Hossein Sadeghnezhad, Ayob Akbari
pmc-13531889.description: IntroductionBuilding leadership capacity among nursing managers is essential for improving healthcare quality and organizational performance. Although value creation has been widely discussed as an organizational outcome within value-based healthcare, its role as a developmental process underlying capacity building remains poorly understood. This study explored how nursing managers develop leadership capacity through value-creating experiences across personal, social, and professional contexts.

uslaw-fr-e8-9510.description: Notice published in the Federal Register on 2008-04-30 by Federal Maritime Commission. Text from federalregister.gov (official edition: govinfo). [FR Doc No: E8-9510] ======================================================================= ----------------------------------------------------------------------- FEDERAL MARITIME COMMISSION Notice of Agreements Filed The Commission hereby gives notice of the filing of the following agreements under the Shipping Act of 1984. Interested parties may submit comments on agreements to the Secretary, Federal Maritime Commission, Washington, DC 20573, within ten days of the date this.
